summary: Weave Communications filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026, disclosing early termination of the HSR antitrust waiting period for its previously announced August 18, 2026 merger with Willow Parent, LLC and Willow Merger Sub, Inc., affiliates of Francisco Partners Management, L.P. The deal is structured as a merger of Merger Sub into Weave, with Weave surviving as a wholly owned Francisco Partners subsidiary — effectively a going-private takeout of the NYSE-listed software company. The HSR clearance satisfies one closing condition; the merger remains subject to customary conditions, notably Weave stockholder approval, with closing expected in Q4 2026. Arbitration angle: watch proxy timing, any competing bid, and litigation risk before the vote.
